articles.description: Investors sought to navigate a choppy week for equities, starting with a fresh bout of volatility for the AI trade when the US introduced new restrictions on China's access to high-end AI chips following a spying controversy dogging Nvidia. The fresh curbs presented President Xi Jinping and President Donald Trump with a dilemma, threatening a fragile trade truce as the two met at the APEC leaders' summit in Shenzhen. As investors grappled with the reality that Nvidia sits at center of the AI ecosystem, questions are emerging about how a shift in leadership at the company and global AI policy could cause a shake-up in the stability of global semiconductor supply chains. The Opening Trade spoke to market experts and leading geopolitical voices throughout the week. (Source: Bloomberg)
